    (∀ i r, start ≤ i → i < start + k → P i r → ∃ r', f i r = ForInStep.yield r' ∧ P (i+1) r') →
    P (start + k) (forIn (m := Id) (List.range' start k) init f) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro start init h0 _; simpa using h0
  | succ k ih =>
    intro start init h0 hstep
    rw [List.range'_succ, List.forIn_cons]
    obtain ⟨r', hr', hP⟩ := hstep start init le_rfl (by omega) h0
    rw [hr']
    have := ih (start + 1) r' hP (fun i r h1 h2 hP' => hstep i r (by omega) (by omega) hP')
    rw [show start + (k + 1) = start + 1 + k by omega]
    exact this

theorem forIn_range_inv {β : Type} (P : Nat → β → Prop) (Q : β → Prop) (start stop : Nat) (init : β)
    (f : Nat → β → Id (ForInStep β))
    (hle : start ≤ stop) (h0 : P start init)
    (hstep : ∀ i r, start ≤ i → i < stop → P i r → ∃ r', f i r = ForInStep.yield r' ∧ P (i+1) r')

  simp only [Std.Range.size]
  have := forIn_range'_inv P f (stop - start) start init h0
    (fun i r h1 h2 hP => hstep i r h1 (by omega) hP)
  rw [show start + (stop - start) = stop by omega] at this
  exact hQ _ this

  simp only [Id.run_bind, Id.run_pure]

  · intro i r h1 h2 hP
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
    simp only at hP ⊢

  rw [editDistance]
